metadata.name: Text-to-Speech Tool
metadata.description: Tool registry integration for text-to-speech synthesis using Coqui TTS with multiple models, voices, and 1100+ language support
metadata.author: automated-developer

globalContext.architectures: Tacotron2, Glow-TTS, FastPitch, VITS, XTTS v2, Bark, Tortoise
globalContext.fairseqLanguages: 1100+ languages via Facebook MMS/Fairseq VITS models
globalContext.presetVoices: Multi-speaker models include preset speaker voices
globalContext.outputFormat: WAV audio at model-specific sample rates (22050Hz-24000Hz typical)

goals.objective: Initialize Python project with Coqui TTS dependencies for text-to-speech synthesis

success: Project structure with pyproject.toml and requirements.txt
TTS package installed via pip install TTS
PyTorch installed with optional CUDA support

constraints: espeak-ng required for phonemization on Linux

context.pipInstall: pip install TTS torch torchaudio scipy soundfile

goals.objective: Implement model discovery, download, and management for all available TTS and vocoder models

success: Model categorization: by language, architecture, quality tier
acceptance: Model info includes language, dataset, description

constraints: Support offline mode with pre-downloaded models

goals.objective: Implement core TTS engine wrapper providing unified interface across all model architectures

success: synthesize(text, model, speaker, language) generates audio
Automatic vocoder selection for spectrogram models
Supports all TTS architectures: Tacotron2, VITS, Glow-TTS, etc.
acceptance: Graceful fallback if vocoder not specified

constraints: End-to-end models (VITS) don't need separate vocoder
Model loading latency on first request

context.spectrogramModels: Tacotron, Tacotron2, Glow-TTS, FastPitch, FastSpeech2 (need vocoder)
context.endToEndModels: VITS, XTTS v2, YourTTS, Bark, Tortoise (integrated vocoder)

goals.objective: Implement speaker selection and management for multi-speaker TTS models

success: list_speakers(model) returns available speakers for model
Default speaker selection when not specified

constraints: Single-speaker models don't support speaker selection
Speaker format varies: index, name, or ID depending on model

context.xttsPresets: Ana Florence, Craig Gutsy, etc. built into XTTS v2
context.speakerArg: speaker or speaker_idx parameter depending on model

goals.objective: Implement language detection, validation, and Fairseq multi-lingual model support

success: Fairseq model name generation from ISO language codes

constraints: Quality varies by language data availability
Some languages require uroman for romanization

context.commonLanguages: en, es, fr, de, it, pt, zh, ja, ko, ru, ar, hi
context.romanizationExtra: pip install TTS[languages] for uroman support

goals.objective: Implement text preprocessing including normalization, phonemization, and SSML parsing

success: phonemize(text, language) converts to phonemes if needed
parse_ssml(ssml) extracts text and prosody hints

constraints: SSML support is partial (basic tags only)

context.ssmlTags: speak, prosody (rate, pitch, volume), break, say-as
context.maxLength: Model-specific max input length, typically 500-1000 chars

goals.objective: Implement audio post-processing for output format conversion and enhancement

success: convert_format(audio, target_format) handles WAV, MP3, OGG

constraints: MP3 encoding requires lame or ffmpeg
Preserve original if no post-processing requested

goals.objective: Implement end-to-end synthesis pipeline from text input to audio file output

success: synthesize(text, config) -> SynthesisResult with audio path
Pipeline: preprocess -> model inference -> postprocess -> save
acceptance: Handles texts of any length via chunking

constraints: Long text split at sentence boundaries

context.pipelineSteps: 1. Text normalization -> 2. Chunking -> 3. Model inference -> 4. Concatenation -> 5. Post-processing -> 6. Save

goals.objective: Implement intelligent model selection based on language, quality, and performance requirements

success: recommend_model(language, quality, speed) suggests best model
Fallback chain if preferred model unavailable
acceptance: High quality tier uses VITS/XTTS when available

constraints: Not all languages have high-quality models

context.highQualityModels: VITS, XTTS v2 (slower but better quality)
context.fairseqFallback: Use Fairseq VITS for uncommon languages

goals.objective: Define JSON schema for tts tool interface with comprehensive synthesis options

success: Input schema: action, text, model, speaker, language, output_format, output_path
Output schema: audio_path, duration_ms, sample_rate, characters_processed
Action types: synthesize, list_models, list_speakers, list_languages, get_model_info
acceptance: Schema validates with JSON Schema Draft-07

constraints: model defaults to fast English model if not specified

context.actions: synthesize | list_models | list_speakers | list_languages | get_model_info | recommend_model
context.synthesizeOptional: model, speaker, language, output_format, output_path, speed, pitch

goals.objective: Implement tool registry handler for JSON request processing and TTS dispatch

success: synthesize action generates speech from text
list_models returns available models with metadata
Proper error handling with descriptive messages
acceptance: All actions return valid JSON per schema

constraints: Model loading cached for repeat requests

context.caching: LRU cache for loaded models, configurable max models in memory

goals.objective: Create CLI for standalone TTS tool invocation and model management

success: tts-tool synthesize 'Hello world' -o output.wav generates speech
acceptance: Help text documents all commands and options

context.cliCommands: synthesize, models, speakers, languages, info, download

goals.objective: Implement HTTP API server for TTS service deployment

success: POST /synthesize accepts text and returns audio
acceptance: Audio returned as file or base64

goals.objective: Implement caching for synthesized audio to avoid redundant computation

success: Cache lookup by text hash + model + speaker + params

constraints: Hash must include all synthesis parameters

context.cacheKey: sha256(text + model + speaker + language + speed + pitch)

goals.objective: Implement batch processing for synthesizing multiple texts efficiently

success: batch_synthesize(texts, config) processes list of texts

context.inputFormats: List of texts, CSV file, JSON array
context.outputFormats: Individual files, ZIP archive, JSON with base64
context.parallelism: CPU: multiprocessing, GPU: sequential with batched inference where supported

goals.objective: Write comprehensive tests for TTS synthesis, model management, and API endpoints

acceptance: Fast test suite (<2 min excluding model downloads)

context.mockStrategy: Mock TTS class for unit tests

goals.objective: Write comprehensive documentation for TTS tool usage, models, and deployment

success: README with installation and quick start

context.sections: Overview, Installation, Quick Start, CLI Reference, HTTP API, Models, Languages, Speakers, Configuration, Deployment, Troubleshooting

goals.objective: Package tts tool for registration with tool registry

success: Health check verifies default model availability
acceptance: Model download on first use works

constraints: Default model auto-downloaded on first use
Document which models are bundled vs downloaded

context.manifestDescription: Text-to-speech synthesis using Coqui TTS with 1100+ languages and multiple voice models
